Marissa has hiked a total of 6 miles (4 + 2) in 2 hours (1 + 1). The total trail is 12 miles, so she has 6 miles left. To achieve an average speed of 4 miles per hour over the entire 12-mile trail, the total time must be 12 miles ÷ 4 mph = 3 hours. She has already used 2 hours, so she has exactly 1 hour remaining to cover the last 6 miles. Therefore, her required speed is 6 miles ÷ 1 hour = 6 mph.

Answer: 6
